description: This is a Java test class for the InboundMappingProcessor component, testing message processing, mapping, and error handling in the context of Eclipse Ditto's messaging connectivity.

classes.name: InboundMappingProcessorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the InboundMappingProcessor class, covering various message mapping scenarios including success, failure, dropping, and duplication.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes shared resources and configurations before all tests, including setting up ActorSystem and mocks.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources after all tests, shutting down the ActorSystem.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Prepares the InboundMappingProcessor instance before each test with configured mappings and context.

methods.name: testInboundMessageMapped
methods.description: Tests that an inbound message is correctly mapped and processed.

methods.name: testInboundMessageWithCondition
methods.description: Tests message processing when a condition (correlation id) is used.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDropped
methods.description: Verifies that a message mapped with a dropping mapper is dropped.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDuplicated
methods.description: Tests that messages are duplicated when configured to do so.

methods.name: testInboundMappingFails
methods.description: Tests behavior when message mapping fails.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedFailedMappedDuplicated
methods.description: Checks combined behaviors of dropping, failing, mapping, and duplication.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDefaultMapper
methods.description: Test that Hono empty notification messages are dropped with default mapper.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDittoMapper
methods.description: Test that such messages are dropped when using Ditto mapper.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDittoByAliasMapper
methods.description: Test for dropping Hono notifications with by-alias Ditto mapper.

methods.name: testInboundFailedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithCustomDittoMapper
methods.description: Ensure processing fails for empty notifications with custom Ditto mapper.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForCustomContentType
methods.description: Verifies messages with specific content type are dropped.

methods.name: testInbound
methods.description: Helper method to test inbound message processing with specified expected outcomes.

methods.name: testInboundWithCor
methods.description: Helper method for testing with correlation ID headers.

methods.name: testInbound (overload)
methods.description: Core test implementation verifying message processing outcomes and invoking mock verifications.
